findings.title: Sunday has no bar and no value

location.description: The Deliveries by weekday chart, at the right end where Sunday should be.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer cannot tell whether nothing was delivered on Sunday or whether the data is missing, because the slot is empty and carries no number.

current.value: The Sunday slot shows its label and an empty space, with no bar and no value.

findings.target: Sunday shows either a bar or a plain value such as zero, so an empty day is not mistaken for missing data.
findings.fix_direction: Show the value of Sunday, including when it is zero.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information, on showing all the data

closed_when.check: Look at the right end of the weekday chart and check that Sunday shows a value or a bar.

findings.title: Only the busiest weekday has a value

location.description: The Deliveries by weekday chart, above the highlighted bar.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer can read the Tuesday value but has to guess the others from bar heights, since the chart has no scale.

current.value: One number, 1,140, sits above the highlighted bar; the other bars carry no number and the chart has no value axis.

findings.target: A viewer can read the approximate value of any weekday, not only the highlighted one.
findings.fix_direction: Give the viewer a way to read the other bars, with a scale or a small number on each.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information, on data-ink and labelling

closed_when.check: Look at the weekday chart and check that a value for a weekday other than the highlighted one can be read.
